title: Wed 11 Nov · evening check
summary:
[b]Today:[/b] more Fed officials backed further hikes (Logan: two more, maybe faster); December hike priced ~88–91%, January above 60%. BoJ December pricing eased to ~70–75%. OPEC+ output jumped ~2 mb/d in October. ECB December hike priced ~78%.
[b]Tomorrow:[/b] UK Q3 GDP 09:00 Bucharest.

EUR.note: ECB December pricing trimmed to 78% as oil cooled; no French item.

GBP.note: No new item; UK Q3 GDP tomorrow 09:00.

JPY.note: BoJ December OIS ~75%, swaps ~70% → R2 0 better supported.

CAD.note: OPEC+ October output +2 mb/d supports the bearish case.

XAU.status: INVALIDATED by written rule (model still bullish)
XAU.note: Gold own score +7 or +4; XAU +14 or +11.

pairs.hook: Same direction as Monday, only with more fuel in the dollar's tank.
pairs.note:
